Position the steering wheel spokes in a position corresponding to driving in a straight line.

1. Undo the fixing bolt and disconnect the steering column from the steering box pinion.

The bolt is the pre-treated type and it therefore cannot be reused when refitting.

Avoid rotating the steering column until the steering column has been reconnected once again to the steering box making sure that the latter is positioned centrally.
